products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as providing trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and now operates as an independent entity offering a range of products aimed at healthcare providers, payers, life sciences organizations, and clinical researchers.

Its product portfolio includes Micromedex, a clinical decision support solution designed to give clinicians point-of-care insights; Zelta, a cloud-based unified clinical data management and acquisition platform built for clinical trials; and the Merge suite of enterprise imaging tools, which includes Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo carrying a 2025 Best in KLAS ranking. The company also offers Truven, which provides health data, analytics, and consulting services, as well as a real-world evidence portfolio of data, services, and applications.

The site's held facts categorize Merative under healthcare and life sciences AI, noting its focus on healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available facts.
